purpose: Source Sans Pro (licenses.json) has no glyphs for these characters, so each browser drew them in its own system font: the four arrows, the minus sign, the status signs (check, cross, circle, square, circled slash, pause, play), the warning sign, the multiplication x, command and return, and the less-or-equal, greater-or-equal and almost-equal signs. Small Noto subsets supply exactly these, under the CSS family 'Source Sans Pro' with a unicode-range each (index.css), so they are the same everywhere. Where a variable Noto face has a symbol, it is as heavy as the letters beside it (Design D100, D101): each face of the text gets the weight whose stroke is as thick as that face's 'l' stem. The rest come from faces with one weight; one file serves both faces, never faked bold.

target_stems.note: Stems in font units per 1000 em, measured on the outlines with fontTools. A ratio is the symbol's stroke over the 'l' stem of the face beside it.

instance.stem: Shafts at wght 700: right and down 82, left 82.26, up 82.87 per 1000 em; the 'l' stem of sourcesanspro-regular.ttf is 82.03 (ratios 1.00, 1.00, 1.01). Of wght 100..900 in steps of 10, 700 is the closest for the right and down arrows (the default 400 is 42, half the stem); the up arrow's own closest, 690 (81.33), differs by 0.9%.
instance.command: uvx --from fonttools==4.66.1 --with brotli==1.2.0 fonttools varLib.instancer 'NotoSansSymbols[wght].ttf' wght=700 --update-name-table --no-recalc-timestamp -o NotoSansSymbols-wght700.ttf

instance.stem: The bar at wght 500 is 81.8 per 1000 em; the 'l' stem of sourcesanspro-regular.ttf is 82.03 (ratio 1.00). Of wght 100..900 in steps of 10, 500 is the closest. Noto Sans Symbols also has U+2212, but as short as a hyphen (ink 242 wide); Noto Sans' minus is as wide as a plus sign (ink 474.5; Source Sans Pro's plus 428.7).
instance.command: uvx --from fonttools==4.66.1 --with brotli==1.2.0 fonttools varLib.instancer 'NotoSans[wdth,wght].ttf' wght=500 wdth=100 --no-recalc-timestamp -o NotoSans-wght500.ttf

weight.static: One weight (Regular 400); this file serves both faces and is never faked bold. Of the surveyed sources (Noto Sans Symbols [wght], Noto Sans Symbols 2, Noto Sans Math, Noto Sans [wdth,wght]), only Noto Sans Symbols 2 has the ballot x, the pause sign, the multiplication x and the command sign; play and warning are as #22 shipped them.
weight.stems: Per 1000 em, with the ratio to the regular and semibold 'l' stems (82.03, 114.75): ballot x U+2717 115.46 and 99.3 (1.41 and 1.21; 1.01 and 0.87); pause U+23F8 bars 152 and 153 (1.85 and 1.87; 1.32 and 1.33), 656 tall (cap height 1.00); multiplication x U+2715 76.37 and 75.92 (0.93; 0.67 and 0.66); command U+2318 70 (0.85; 0.61).

Black square U+25A0 is solid: 714 tall, against the cap heights 655.76 and 653.81 (1.09).
